Some of the materials we work with include epoxy resin, artistic hardwood, and live edge slabs. We have the experience and expertise necessary to ensure you're satisfied with the final product. about:
Valhalla Millworks operates in Galloway, New Jersey, providing custom woodworking services to the local area.

The shop produces custom cutting boards, furniture, tables, and other wood items, working with materials such as epoxy resin, artistic hardwood, and live edge slabs.

The business serves residential customers, as evidenced by client testimonials describing coffee tables, end tables, and slab selections for home projects.

The company emphasizes experience and expertise to ensure customer satisfaction, and offers home delivery with setup and removal of packaging.
